title: Note required option on checkbox and per-axle fields, on by default
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with "Settings - Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  • A template with a Checkbox field and a Per-axle measurement field.
custom_steps:
1. In the template builder, add a Checkbox field and open its authoring options.
  2. Add a Per-axle measurement field and open its authoring options.
  3. Read the "Note required if Monitor / Not OK" option and its default state on each.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A checkbox field's authoring options include an option, "Note required if Monitor / Not OK".
  • That option is on by default for a newly added checkbox field.
  • The same option is also available on a per-axle measurement field.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9099 (S1 — Require a note on flagged responses); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S1; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “A checkbox field will offer an authoring option, "Note required if Monitor / Not OK"”
  • S1-R2: “The option will be on by default for newly added checkbox fields”
  • S1-R6: “The same option will apply to per-axle measurement fields”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
